title: Kingston Cola 120ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
Made in the UK
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
– 100ml E-Liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 10ml (18mg) Nicotine shots
– 70VG/30PG
– Childproof Cap and Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD Complaint
Flavours:
Classic Cola
In the form of a refreshing all day vape, the classic poptastic cola drink flavour.
Cherry Cola
The equally poptastic cherry cola flavour with it’s distinctive fizzy, cherry taste now made for refreshing all day vapes.
Vanilla Cola
The blending of vanilla flavoured ice cream with classic cola is poptastic tasting all day vape.
Raspberry Cola
The distinctive, fruity blend of raspberry and cola into a poptastic drink flavour that will make for a refreshing all day vape.
Mango Cola
Taking the tropical, ripe flavour of mangoes with that of the classic poptastic cola flavour into something smooth, refreshing and cool as an all day vape.
